title: SB536 (2019 Regular): Public Safety - Education - Firearm Funding

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2019RS/bills/sb/sb0536f.pdf)

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Education § 7-117): (B) NOTWITHSTANDING ANY OTHER PROVISION OF LAW, A COUNTY BOARD OR PUBLIC SCHOOL MAY NOT SPEND ANY MONEY FROM ANY SOURCE, INCLUDING FROM LOCAL, STATE, FEDERAL, OR PRIVATE REVENUE SOURCES, TO DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY PROVIDE A TEACHER WITH A FIREARM.
